FX bugged when joining mid game

comment.text: Players joining mid game will see render FX. The workaround is to disabled and re-enable the FX. However this causes with performance client side if enabled all at once. Doing them in blocks of 5 with a 66ms delay allows enough time to update while minimizing other elements like the UI.
